title: Sound Exchange
blurb: Press a playlist into a battle creature. The title shapes its body; every song adds a part, stats, a move and a sound. Fight rivals in 3D rhythm-timed JRPG battles with wireframe move effects while the music follows your genre mix.
controls: Type an artist or song and pick a suggestion (or tap a sample), then press. In battle pick a move, then tap (or Space) on the beat to power it up; when the foe attacks, tap on the beat to guard. 3D button toggles 3D; drag the 3D card model to spin it.
